note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The two boards are identical except for ONE fact: the supplied datum printed on the filter tag (A: outcomes.maintained, B: outcomes.suspended). The gate only follows that datum; the consequence is geometric (the decision card passes or waits). No winner, score or outcome; no suspension doctrine, dates or time limits. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, objectLabels and the comparison fields are editable.
